label: Division
title: Division A
text: Compliance, Objectives and Functional Statements

label: Part
title: Part 1
text: Compliance

label: Section
title: Section 1.1.
text: General

label: Subsection
text: Application of this Code

label: Article
text: Application of this Code

label: Sentence
text: This Code applies to any one or more of the following:

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the design of a new building ,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the construction of a new building ,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the occupancy of any building ,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: the change in occupancy of any building ,

label: Clause
title: e)
text: an alteration to any building ,

label: Clause
title: f)
text: an addition to any building ,

label: Clause
title: g)
text: the demolition of any building ,

label: Clause
title: h)
text: the reconstruction of any building that has been damaged by fire, earthquake or other cause,

label: Clause
title: i)
text: the correction of an unsafe condition in or about any building or property,

label: Clause
title: j)
text: all parts of any building affected by a change in occupancy ,

label: Clause
title: k)
text: the work necessary to ensure safety in parts of any building that

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: remain after demolition, or

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: are affected by, but are not directly involved in, additions or alterations ,

label: Clause
title: l)
text: the installation, replacement, or alteration of materials regulated by this Code,

label: Clause
title: m)
text: the installation, replacement, or alteration of equipment regulated by this Code,

label: Clause
title: n)
text: the work necessary to ensure safety in a relocated building during and after relocation, and

label: Clause
title: o)
text: safety during construction of a project , including protection of the public and neighbouring properties.

label: Sentence
text: This Code applies to both site-built and factory-constructed buildings . (See Note A-1.1.1.1.(2).)

label: Sentence
text: This Code does not permit the construction of a building for which a land use is not allowed pursuant to an airport vicinity protection area regulation under the Municipal Government Act.

label: Sentence
text: This Code does not apply to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: a building of low human occupancy associated with the operation of the farm on which it is located, where the building is used for the

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: housing of livestock,

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: storage or maintenance of equipment, or

label: Subclause
title: iii)
text: storage of materials or produce, (see Note A-1.1.1.1.(4)(a)),

label: Clause
title: b)
text: utility towers and poles, television and radio or other communications antennas or towers, except that loads resulting from those located on or attached to a building shall be included in the building design,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: water conveyance and control structures, except for an associated building provided for occupancy ,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: highway and railway bridges,

label: Clause
title: e)
text: mechanical process equipment and appliances in an industrial occupancy that are not required for building services and are not specifically regulated by this Code,

label: Clause
title: f)
text: an accessory building not greater than 10 m 2 in building area that does not create a hazard, or

label: Clause
title: g)
text: the category of elevating devices and amusement rides regulated under other regulations made pursuant to the Safety Codes Act, except for ramps, stairs, platforms and associated buildings .

label: Article
text: Application to Existing Buildings (See Note A-1.1.1.2.)

label: Sentence
text: This Article applies to a building that legally existed before 01 May 2024.

label: Sentence
text: If a building is altered, rehabilitated, refurbished, renovated or repaired, the level of life safety and building performance shall not be decreased.

label: Sentence
text: Except as specified in Part 10 of Division B, the authority having jurisdiction shall accept any construction or condition that lawfully exists in Alberta.

label: Sentence
text: A change in occupancy or alteration of any building shall be permitted if the level of safety and building performance proposed are acceptable to the authority having jurisdiction .

label: Sentence
text: The authority having jurisdiction may accept an alternative or a proposal that achieves the appropriate level of safety for the specific activity for which the building is to be used.

label: Sentence
text: The authority having jurisdiction may accept existing construction not in complete compliance with this Code and may place conditions on the existing construction.

label: Section
title: Section 1.2.
text: Compliance

label: Subsection
text: Compliance with this Code

label: Article
text: Compliance with this Code

label: Sentence
text: Compliance with this Code shall be achieved by

label: Clause
title: a)
text: complying with the applicable acceptable solutions in Division B (see Note A-1.2.1.1.(1)(a)), or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: using alternative solutions that will achieve at least the minimum level of performance required by Division B in the areas defined by the objectives and functional statements attributed to the applicable acceptable solutions (see Note A-1.2.1.1.(1)(b)).

label: Sentence
text: For the purposes of compliance with this Code as required in Clause 1.2.1.1.(1)(b), the objectives and functional statements attributed to the acceptable solutions in Division B shall be the objectives and functional statements referred to in Subsection 1.1.2. of Division B.

label: Subsection
text: Materials, Appliances, Systems and Equipment

label: Article
text: Characteristics of Materials, Appliances, Systems and Equipment

label: Sentence
text: All materials, appliances , systems and equipment installed to meet the requirements of this Code shall possess the necessary characteristics to perform their intended functions when installed in a building .

label: Sentence
text: Evaluation reports issued by the Canadian Construction Materials Centre, National Research Council of Canada, or an organization approved by the Provincial Building Administrator may be used in determining compliance with the requirements of this Code.

label: Sentence
text: The Provincial Building Administrator may issue lists of materials or products that satisfy the requirements of this Code and, after listing, may be used to fulfill the requirements of this Code.

label: Article
text: Storage on the Building Site

label: Sentence
text: All building materials, appliances and equipment on the building site shall be stored in such a way as to prevent the deterioration or impairment of their essential properties.

label: Article
text: Used Materials, Appliances and Equipment

label: Sentence
text: Unless otherwise specified, used materials, appliances and equipment are permitted to be reused when they meet the requirements of this Code for new materials, appliances and equipment and are satisfactory for the intended use.

label: Article
text: Asbestos

label: Sentence
text: Products containing asbestos shall not be installed in a building .

label: Section
title: Section 1.3.
text: Divisions A, B and C of this Code

label: Subsection
text: General

label: Article
text: Scope of Division A

label: Sentence
text: Division A contains the compliance and application provisions, objectives and functional statements of this Code.

label: Article
text: Scope of Division B

label: Sentence
text: Division B contains the acceptable solutions of this Code.

label: Article
text: Scope of Division C

label: Sentence
text: Division C contains the administrative provisions of this Code.

label: Article
text: Internal Cross-references

label: Sentence
text: Where the Division of a referenced provision is not specified in this Code, it shall mean that the referenced provision is in the same Division as the referencing provision.

label: Subsection
text: Application of Division A

label: Article
text: Application of Parts 1, 2 and 3

label: Sentence
text: Parts 1, 2 and 3 of Division A apply to all buildings covered in this Code. (See Article 1.1.1.1.)

label: Subsection
text: Application of Division B

label: Article
text: Application of Parts 1, 7 and 8

label: Sentence
text: Parts 1, 7 and 8 of Division B apply to all buildings covered in this Code. (See Article 1.1.1.1.)

label: Article
text: Application of Parts 3, 4, 5 and 6

label: Sentence
text: Parts 3, 4, 5, and 6 of Division B apply to all buildings described in Article 1.1.1.1. and

label: Clause
title: a)
text: classified as post-disaster buildings ,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: used for major occupancies classified as

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: Group A, assembly occupancies ,

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: Group B, care , treatment or detention occupancies , or

label: Subclause
title: iii)
text: Group F, Division 1, high-hazard industrial occupancies , or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: exceeding 600 m 2 in building area or exceeding 3 storeys in building height used for major occupancies classified as

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: Group C, residential occupancies ,

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: Group D, business and personal services occupancies ,

label: Subclause
title: iii)
text: Group E, mercantile occupancies , or

label: Subclause
title: iv)
text: Group F, Divisions 2 and 3, medium- and low-hazard industrial occupancies .

label: Article
text: Application of Parts 9, 10 and 11

label: Sentence
text: Part 9 of Division B applies to all buildings described in Article 1.1.1.1. of 3 storeys or less in building height , having a building area not exceeding 600 m 2 , and used for major occupancies classified as

label: Clause
title: a)
text: Group B, Division 4, home-type care occupancies ,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Group C, residential occupancies (see Note A-9.1.1.1.(1) of Division B),

label: Clause
title: c)
text: Group D, business and personal services occupancies ,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: Group E, mercantile occupancies , or

label: Clause
title: e)
text: Group F, Divisions 2 and 3, medium- and low-hazard industrial occupancies .

label: Sentence
text: Part 10 of Division B applies to all buildings described in Article 1.1.1.1. conforming to Sentence (3) in which accommodation is provided for an industrial workforce living and working in a temporary location.

label: Sentence
text: Part 10 of Division B applies to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: one- storey buildings

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: without sleeping accommodation that are not more than 1 200 m 2 in building area or, if sprinklered , that are not more than 2 400 m 2 in building area , or

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: with sleeping accommodation that are not more than 600 m 2 in building area or, if sprinklered , that are not more than 1 200 m 2 in building area , and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: two- storey buildings

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: without sleeping accommodation that are not more than 600 m 2 in building area or, if sprinklered , that are not more than 1 200 m 2 in building area , or

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: with sleeping accommodation that are not more than 300 m 2 in building area or, if sprinklered , that are not more than 600 m 2 in building area .

label: Sentence
text: Part 10 of Division B applies to Group D and Group F, Division 3 occupancies conforming to Sentence (3) for an industrial workforce working in a temporary location.

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted in Sentence (6), Part 11 of Division B applies to a building constructed within an airport vicinity protection area that has been established by an airport vicinity protection area regulation under the Municipal Government Act.

label: Sentence
text: Part 11 of Division B does not apply

label: Clause
title: a)
text: to buildings for which a land use is allowed by an airport vicinity protection area regulation under the Municipal Government Act and the regulation does not place any conditions with respect to acoustic insulation,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: to any part of a building that is not designed for winter use when the outside temperature is below 0°C, or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: to buildings that were completed before 30 November 1983 or for which a building permit was issued before 30 November 1983.

label: Article
text: Building Size Determination

label: Sentence
text: Where a firewall divides a building , each portion of the building so divided shall be considered as a separate building , except when this requirement is specifically modified in other parts of this Code. (See Note A-1.3.3.4.(1).)

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted in Sentence (3), where portions of a building are completely separated by a vertical fire separation that has a fire-resistance rating of not less than 1 h and extends through all storeys and service spaces of the separated portions, each separated portion is permitted to be considered as a separate building for the purpose of determining building height , provided

label: Clause
title: a)
text: each separated portion is not more than 4 storeys in building height and is used only for assembly , residential , and business and personal services occupancies , and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the unobstructed path of travel for a firefighter from the nearest street to one entrance of each separated portion is not more than 45 m. (See Note A-1.3.3.4.(2).)

label: Sentence
text: The vertical fire separation referred to in Sentence (2) may terminate at the floor assembly immediately above a basement provided the basement conforms to Article 3.2.1.2. of Division B.

label: Article
text: Buildings Divided into Strata Space (See Note A-1.3.3.5.)

label: Sentence
text: Where subdividing volumetric space creates a boundary in or through a building , which otherwise complies with this Code, and where such space is shown as strata space on a strata space plan,

label: Clause
title: a)
text: such a building or portion of a building shall be considered as a single building not requiring internal firewalls or party walls along the strata space property lines, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the limiting distances of such a building or portion of a building shall be measured only to the outside property lines of the land shown as a single parcel on a plan of survey registered under the Land Titles Act and its Regulations and need not be considered between separate strata spaces where these spaces form part of the same building .

label: Subsection
text: Application of Division C

label: Article
text: Application of Parts 1 and 2

label: Sentence
text: Parts 1 and 2 of Division C apply to all buildings covered in this Code. (See Article 1.1.1.1.)

label: Section
title: Section 1.4.
text: Terms and Abbreviations

label: Subsection
text: Definitions of Words and Phrases

label: Article
text: Non-defined Terms

label: Sentence
text: Words and phrases used in this Code that are not included in the list of definitions in Article 1.4.1.2. shall have the meanings defined in the Safety Codes Act and its Regulations, or the meanings that are commonly assigned to them in the context in which they are used, taking into account the specialized use of terms by the various trades and professions to which the terminology applies.

label: Sentence
text: Where objectives and functional statements are referred to in this Code, they shall be the objectives and functional statements described in Parts 2 and 3.

label: Sentence
text: Where acceptable solutions are referred to in this Code, they shall be the provisions stated in Parts 3 to 11 of Division B.

label: Sentence
text: Where alternative solutions are referred to in this Code, they shall be the alternative solutions mentioned in Clause 1.2.1.1.(1)(b).

label: Sentence
text: For words not defined by Sentence (1), reference should be made to the Oxford University Press 2004, “Canadian Oxford Dictionary, 2nd Edition.”
